title: Luxurious!
text: Luxurious!. These sheets are amazing! They are so luxurious. These have to be my favorite sheets ever! After a few nights of sleeping with these sheets, I've ordered another set! They are so soft. They have a slightly slick feeling, but not slippery like satin or silk. They seem to retain less body heat than cotton sheets. I would not call them cooling sheets, but they are cooler than a lot of sheets. I have a sleep number bed with a padded topper. These easily fit over the sheets. They haven't popped off the bed yet either which is pretty impressive. The sheets I was using prior to this set, had to be repositioned almost daily. I highly recommend these!
